categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Newtouch Software Co., Ltd. primarily operates in IT solutions, IT product sales, innovative business, and software development outsourcing. The company focuses on providing software development services, consulting, system integration, and cloud infrastructure services, mainly targeting financial institutions such as banks and insurance companies, as well as other industries including automotive and government sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary technologies in big data, artificial intelligence (AI), mobile internet, and cloud computing. Key platforms include the Newtouch AI platform, Newtouch Big Data Oneclick, and the Newtouch Insurance Data Warehouse Model. It employs advanced AI models such as a 98-billion parameter MoE large model, integrates DevOps, microservices, and distributed architecture, and uses agile development methodologies to enhance software delivery and innovation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Newtouch serves primarily financial institutions including major banks and insurance companies such as China Pacific Insurance, China Life, and China People's Insurance. It also caters to government agencies, automotive companies, and overseas markets. The company’s products and services support digital transformation, AI integration, and IT infrastructure modernization in these sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with headquarters in Shanghai and multiple subsidiaries across major Chinese cities including Beijing, Chengdu, Shenzhen, and Wuhan. It also has subsidiaries in Japan and serves some overseas markets, though the majority of revenue is generated domestically.
categories.supply_chain_position: Newtouch operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the IT supply chain, focusing on software development, IT services, and cloud infrastructure provisioning. It acts as a technology service provider and solutions integrator rather than a hardware manufacturer.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on embracing artificial intelligence, especially generative AI and large language models, to drive innovation in IT services and products. It invests heavily in R&D for AI platforms, cloud computing, big data, blockchain, and privacy computing. The company aims to build a comprehensive AI ecosystem and expand SaaS, flow, and shared IT services, targeting financial and enterprise digital transformation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of IT solutions and software development services, including custom software projects, maintenance, and outsourcing. The company also earns income from IT product sales, innovative digital platforms, and cloud infrastructure services. Sales are mainly conducted via direct sales, tenders, competitive negotiations, and business negotiations.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Newtouch is positioned as a leading domestic software and IT service provider with strong brand recognition in the insurance and banking sectors. It competes with other IT solution providers in China’s software and information technology services industry, maintaining a competitive edge through proprietary AI technologies and deep industry expertise.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Newtouch reported total revenue of approximately RMB 1.995 billion, an 18.57% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 8.09 million, a significant decline due to increased R&D and marketing expenses related to AI investments. The company’s total assets reached RMB 3.1 billion, reflecting steady growth and ongoing investment in technology and infrastructure.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Newtouch emphasizes its deep industry experience, proprietary AI and big data technologies, and comprehensive IT solutions tailored for financial institutions. Its unique value lies in integrating AI large models with industry-specific knowledge bases, enabling clients to achieve digital transformation and intelligent automation. The company’s platforms support end-to-end AI lifecycle management, enhancing operational efficiency and customer engagement.
